tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC with 5-Part Diff)
tests.description: Comprehensive hematologic evaluation including RBC, WBC, Hemoglobin, Hematocrit, Platelets, and automated 5-part differential.
tests.preparation: No fasting required. Maintain routine hydration.

tests.name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP 14)
tests.description: 14 essential biomarkers evaluating electrolyte balance, renal filtration, hepatic enzymes, and blood glucose.
tests.preparation: Overnight 10-12 hour fasting required. Plain water permitted.

tests.name: Advanced Lipid & Cardiovascular Profile
tests.description: Standard lipid fractions including Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, Triglycerides, and Non-HDL risk ratios.
tests.preparation: 12-hour fasting required. Avoid alcohol 24 hours prior.

tests.name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c with eAG)
tests.description: Monitors 90-day mean glycemic control for diabetes diagnosis and therapeutic management.

tests.name: Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (Ultra-Sensitive TSH)
tests.description: Primary screening assay for primary, secondary, and subclinical thyroid disorders.
tests.preparation: Morning collection recommended. Avoid biotin supplements 48 hours prior.

tests.name: 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D Total (D2 + D3)
tests.description: Quantitative serum chemiluminescent assay for circulating 25-OH Vitamin D status.

tests.name: Urinalysis Complete (Physical, Chemical & Microscopic)
tests.description: Multi-parameter urine reagent strip and automated sediment microscopy examination.
tests.preparation: First morning midstream clean catch preferred.
